## Review finding

**P2 — Fail closed when probing supported config paths**

`findConfigs` silently ignores every `os.Stat` error for the supported standalone config locations. Only a successful stat of a non-directory is recorded; `EACCES`, `EIO`, `ELOOP`, and other failures are treated exactly like “file does not exist.” [.claude/scripts/renovate-dashboard-drift-go/main.goL407-L414](https://github.com/devantler-tech/monorepo/blob/948bb06f73809c3aee43501ed81a0904d0fa218e/.claude/scripts/renovate-dashboard-drift-go/main.go#L407-L414)

For an initialized, undeclared submodule, this can make an inaccessible or cyclic-symlink `renovate.json` produce an empty result. The caller then recognizes the `.git` entry, classifies the repository as checked out and genuinely config-less, and allows the check to pass. [.claude/scripts/renovate-dashboard-drift-go/main.goL271-L284](https://github.com/devantler-tech/monorepo/blob/948bb06f73809c3aee43501ed81a0904d0fa218e/.claude/scripts/renovate-dashboard-drift-go/main.go#L271-L284)

This contradicts the fail-closed handling already applied to errors when inspecting the repository root. [.claude/scripts/renovate-dashboard-drift-go/main.goL390-L400](https://github.com/devantler-tech/monorepo/blob/948bb06f73809c3aee43501ed81a0904d0fa218e/.claude/scripts/renovate-dashboard-drift-go/main.go#L390-L400) Handle each config path as follows:

- `os.ErrNotExist`: config is absent.
- Successful stat of a regular/non-directory entry: config is present.
- Directory or any other stat failure: return an unverifiable-config error.

Add a deterministic test using a symlink loop or `ENOTDIR`, preferably paired with a control confirming that genuinely absent config locations remain accepted.

No files were changed, so no commit or follow-up pull request was created.

**Checks**
* ✅ `go -C .claude/scripts/renovate-dashboard-drift-go test ./...`
* ✅ `bash .claude/scripts/renovate-dashboard-drift.sh --root .` (returned the expected fail-closed diagnostics because the four declared submodules are not initialized in this worktree)
* ⚠️ `shellcheck .claude/scripts/renovate-dashboard-drift.sh` (ShellCheck is not installed in the environment)
* ✅ `git diff --check abffed72bf5b9a8af00b7d357f2cf554a18a7e80..HEAD`
* ✅ `git status --short` (clean worktree)
